summary: Iteration 10: Tested NEW scoring engine (Res 0312/2019 alignment) and new audit fields (team, COPASST, times). All 16 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified with all new fields present in Programar Auditoria dialog and Score card visible in Execution tab.
passed_tests: GET /api/audits/{audit_id}/score - returns 200 with percentage, classification, by_cycle, by_standard
Score response has correct structure: percentage, classification (level, label, color, action), by_cycle (PHVA), total_possible, total_obtained
Score classification thresholds: <60% = CRITICO, 60-85% = MODERADAMENTE_ACEPTABLE, >85% = ACEPTABLE
Score endpoint requires authentication (401 without auth)
POST /api/audits - accepts all new fields: start_time, end_time, additional_auditors, process_responsibles, copasst_member
POST /api/audits - backward compatible (works with minimal fields)
PUT /api/audits/{audit_id} with status=closed FAILS without end_time (400 error)
PUT /api/audits/{audit_id} with status=closed FAILS without copasst_member (400 error)
PUT /api/audits/{audit_id} with status=closed FAILS without auditor (400 error)
PUT /api/audits/{audit_id} with status=closed SUCCEEDS with all required fields
PUT /api/audits/{audit_id} with status=reviewed also enforces business rules
GET /api/audits/{audit_id} - returns score_result with classification
GET /api/audits/{audit_id} - returns all new fields for newly created audits
Scoring logic: cumple=max_score, no_cumple=0, parcial=0, no_aplica=max_score
Frontend: Programar Auditoria dialog shows FECHAS Y HORARIOS section
Frontend: Programar Auditoria dialog shows EQUIPO AUDITOR section with Auditor Lider and Auditores Adicionales
Frontend: Programar Auditoria dialog shows RESPONSABLES DEL PROCESO SG-SST section
Frontend: Programar Auditoria dialog shows MIEMBRO COPASST section (marked as required in red)
Frontend: Execution tab shows Score Res 0312 card with percentage (1.82%), PHVA breakdown, classification badge (Critico)
Frontend: All data-testid attributes present for new fields
critical_code_review_comments: Old audits (created before update) don't have new fields (start_time, end_time, etc.) - this is expected but may need migration if needed
Consider adding aria-describedby to DialogContent to fix accessibility warning
seed_data_creation: None - used existing test audit aud_d44a6cb2 and created/deleted test audits during tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scoring engine (Res 0312/2019) fully tested and working. Score endpoint returns percentage, classification (CRITICO/MODERADAMENTE_ACEPTABLE/ACEPTABLE), PHVA breakdown. New audit fields (start_time, end_time, additional_auditors, process_responsibles, copasst_member) all working. Business rules for closing audits enforced: requires auditor, end_date, end_time, copasst_member.name. Frontend dialog shows all new fields with proper sections.
